I think in most cases, when you open a beer can, you just need to lift the tab to create a small opening. That's enough for drinking because the pressure inside the can allows the beer to flow out. So, maybe removing the entire lid isn't necessary. It might even be a bit messy because without the lid, the beer could spill more easily. On the other hand, some people might prefer removing the lid completely for easier access, especially if they're sharing the beer or using a straw. But I'm not sure if that's common practice.
